summary: By Samuel Lavery (github: samlavery) and his agent team (bridge-port, am-cert, mvt-engine, window-scope); Apache-2.0. Builds on our attempt-023 and on R. Arun Chandru's master-of-puppets Gram-defect chain, all notices kept. New here: the sizer uses Yuhang Shi's anchor-variance term through a certified per-cell curvature table (module PCellVarW, his notice kept), and a range-end tangent anchor (module PCellDKH). Together they remove the basin that limited the certification margin, so the frame-optimum nine-point weights (B = 437542/10^8) are certified at margin about 1.65e-5 with 10,750 leaves. Each leaf certificate is thinned while every margin stays above the floor; the floor c is the exact supremum of the leaf margins, and the window bound keeps our 10^-32 enclosure.
method: Nine-point Gram-defect certificate at the frame-optimum weights, variance-aware sizing with range-end tangent anchors, thinned leaf certificates and the exact maximal floor.
